description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Implemented Microsoft account skin and cape management (upload/reset skin, manage capes).  
2. Refactored offline account skin management; simplified model selection and removed CSL support.  
3. Added -Dmiolibpatcher.alc10=true JVM arg support to fix missing audio on older versions.  
4. Fixed game getting stuck when exiting on 26.2+ versions.  
5. Fixed LWJGL error when attempting to load jemalloc.  
6. Fixed placeholder errors in multilingual string resources and added missing translations.  
7. OpenAL-Soft now uses OpenSL as the default audio backend.  
8. Reworked JRE asset trimming to filter by architecture at build time (smaller APKs).  
9. Optimized CI build pipeline; merged duplicate build jobs and reused workflows.  
10. Moved auto cache cleanup to splash screen with an improved implementation.  
11. Updated LWJGL runtime components and related libraries.  
12. Updated MioLibPatcher, MioLaunchWrapper, FCLBridge runtime components.  
13. Migrated AccountListItem to Kotlin with enhanced null-safety in file selection.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.实现微软账号皮肤与披风管理功能（支持上传、重置皮肤与披风管理）
2.重构离线账户皮肤管理逻辑，简化模型选择并移除 CSL 支持
3.支持 -Dmiolibpatcher.alc10=true 参数，修复低版本游戏无声音的问题
4.修复 26.2+ 版本退出游戏卡住的问题
5.修复 LWJGL 尝试加载 jemalloc 报错的问题
6.修复多语言字符串资源中的占位符错误并补全漏译键
7.OpenAL-Soft 默认改用 OpenSL 作为音频后端
8.重构多架构 JRE 资产裁剪，按架构过滤生成资产源，显著减小安装包体积
9.优化 CI 构建流程，合并重复的构建 job 并复用工作流
10.自动清理缓存逻辑迁移至启动页
11.更新 LWJGL 运行时组件与相关依赖库
12.更新 MioLibPatcher / MioLaunchWrapper / FCLBridge 等运行时组件
13.AccountListItem 迁移至 Kotlin 并增强文件选择逻辑的空安全性
